Quick triage notes (initial):
- Observed the same tail pattern in Datadog (link: https://datadog.redwood.example.com/screen/abc123/websocket-metrics).
- Correlated with a recent autoscaler tweak deployed earlier this morning (autoscale_v2) that changed batching heuristics for websocket worker pools.
- We also see a spike in KV cache misses for tenant_id=mediapulse at the same timestamps. Misses cause expensive cold-path decoding that shows up as long tail latency.

Immediate mitigation options (fastest to implement):
1) Roll back autoscaler change for websocket worker pools (approx 5-8m to cutover).
2) Increase replica count for hosted websocket fleet for the us-west region (fast but heavier infra cost).
3) Enable per-tenant circuit breaker to short-circuit high-latency requests (can be toggled in config, ~3-10m).

I'll run option #1 (rollback batching heuristics) and watch p99. If rollback doesn't move the needle, I'll add replicas. I've attached a snapshot from Datadog (dd-snapshot.png) and will open INF-4829 in Jira with traces and flamegraphs.

- Aditya
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
